fact: The IDS study says Cote d'Ivoire's biometric digital-ID project is backed by the Law on Digital Identification, Law No. 2019-566 (an enacted law of five articles), with an executive decree and the 2013 data protection law alongside it.
source_slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies

fact: The IDS study says Law No. 2019-566 establishes the legal basis for the biometric digital-ID and, in its Article 2, describes the ID as a secure, multi-application electronic smart card; it also says the law incorporates the National Register of Persons (RNPP).
